records.source: Oh! You aren't exactly how I imagined... but that's okay! I'm Jodi.#$e#It's a quiet little town, so it's very exciting when someone new moves in! Having a farmer around could really change things.
records.translation: Ah! Hindi ka eksaktong tulad ng inisip ko... pero ayos lang! Ako si Jodi.#$e#Tahimik na munting bayan ito, kaya kapana-panabik kapag may bagong lumilipat! Talagang maaaring magbago ang mga bagay dahil may magsasaka na rito.

records.source: Ah... You sure you want to give away such a precious item? Well, thank you!
records.translation: Ah... Tiyak ka bang gusto mong ipamigay ang napakahalagang bagay na ito? Aba, salamat!

records.source: What a treat!
records.translation: Napakasayang pagkakataon!

records.source: I think I'll make seafood tonight.$h
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, magluluto ako ng pagkaing-dagat ngayong gabi.$h

records.source: The view is breathtaking! Deep blue as far as the eye can see...
records.translation: Nakahihinto ng hininga ang tanawin! Malalim na asul hanggang sa abot ng mata...

records.source: We all love it when Gus shows up.
records.translation: Gustong-gusto naming lahat kapag dumarating si Gus.

records.source: I heard about you and Sam. Hopefully he won't cause you any trouble!$h
records.translation: Narinig ko ang tungkol sa inyo ni Sam. Sana hindi ka niya bibigyan ng problema!$h

records.source: I'm so happy for you and Sam. I think you two are the perfect match!#$e#I never thought I'd say it... but I'll miss those awful noises from Sam's guitar...$s
records.translation: Napakasaya ko para sa inyo ni Sam. Sa tingin ko, perpekto kayong magkapareha!#$e#Hindi ko inakalang sasabihin ko ito... pero nami-miss ko ang kakila-kilabot na ingay mula sa gitara ni Sam...$s

records.source: Are you alright? We've never seen anything like this before...$s#$e#I wish my husband was here. He'd know exactly what to do.$s
records.translation: Ayos ka lang ba? Hindi pa kami nakakita ng anumang tulad nito...$s#$e#Sana narito ang asawa ko. Malalaman niya kung ano mismo ang dapat gawin.$s

records.source: Vincent got up early to go play in the rain. I just hope they're right about it being completely harmless!
records.translation: Maagang bumangon si Vincent upang maglaro sa ulan. Sana tama sila na hindi talaga ito mapanganib!

records.source: Thanks again for bringing that fish! It was some of the best we've had in a while.
records.translation: Salamat ulit sa pagdadala ng isdang iyon! Isa iyon sa pinakamasarap na nakain namin nitong mga nakaraan.

records.source: *whisper* Did you hear about Shane? That's so terrible... I hope he's doing okay.$s
records.translation: *bulong* Narinig mo ba ang tungkol kay Shane? Napakasama niyon... Sana ayos lang siya.$s

records.source: Wow... I heard what you did for Pam... Boy, I wonder what she did to get in your good graces like that?$s#$e#...I wish I had that kind of money to throw around...$s
records.translation: Wow... Narinig ko ang ginawa mo para kay Pam... Aba, ano kaya ang ginawa niya upang magustuhan mo siya nang ganoon?$s#$e#...Sana may ganoon akong karaming perang maipamimigay...$s

records.source: Did you see Pam's new house? Boy... I wish I had that kind of money... I'd love to get the kitchen remodeled, at least...$s
records.translation: Nakita mo ba ang bagong bahay ni Pam? Aba... Sana may ganoon akong karaming pera... Gustong-gusto kong ipaayos man lang ang kusina...$s

records.source: Poor Clint... they say he's head-over-heels for Emily, but I've heard she only thinks of him as a friend...
records.translation: Kawawang Clint... Sabi nila, patay na patay siya kay Emily, pero narinig kong kaibigan lang ang tingin nito sa kaniya...

records.source: I've been doing aerobics class with the ladies every week...#$b#Recently, someone new joined the class, but he made us all swear we wouldn't reveal his identity!
records.translation: Linggo-linggo akong dumadalo sa klase ng aerobics kasama ang mga babae...#$b#Kamakailan ay may bagong sumali sa klase, pero pinasumpa niya kaming lahat na hindi ibunyag ang pagkakakilanlan niya!

records.source: Penny's a sweet girl. She's been Vincent's teacher for a while now, and he really loves her.
records.translation: Napakabait ni Penny. Matagal-tagal na siyang guro ni Vincent, at talagang mahal siya nito.

records.source: They say the bus is back up and running. I'm sure Pam is happy about that...#$b#I heard she'd been drinking more after losing her job... so hopefully this helps.
records.translation: Sabi nila, bumibiyahe na ulit ang bus. Tiyak na masaya si Pam dahil doon...#$b#Narinig kong mas madalas siyang umiinom matapos mawalan ng trabaho... kaya sana makatulong ito.

records.source: What's this? It looks like one of Kent's buddies from the war. Maybe you should show it to him?
records.translation: Ano ito? Mukha itong isa sa mga kasamahan ni Kent sa digmaan. Baka dapat mo itong ipakita sa kaniya?

records.source: Maintaining a household is difficult work... but somebody has to do it.#$e#Yes?
records.translation: Mahirap na trabaho ang pagpapanatili ng tahanan... pero kailangang may gumawa nito.#$e#Ano iyon?

records.source: It's nice to have a family... but I'd be lying if I said I never miss the freedom of being young...$s
records.translation: Masarap magkaroon ng pamilya... pero magsisinungaling ako kung sasabihin kong hindi ko kailanman nami-miss ang kalayaan ng kabataan...$s

records.source: My husband Kent is a soldier, working overseas. That's why he's not here right now.#$b#I know he'll come back safe once his tour is over!!#$e#Need something?
records.translation: Sundalo ang asawa kong si Kent at nagtatrabaho sa ibang bansa. Kaya wala siya rito ngayon.#$b#Alam kong ligtas siyang babalik kapag natapos ang tungkulin niya!!#$e#May kailangan ka?

records.source: Exercise is important for staying healthy. I always make sure to set aside some time for it.#$e#As a parent, I don't have much time to devote to myself. So I try and make every minute count.
records.translation: Mahalaga ang ehersisyo upang manatiling malusog. Palagi akong naglalaan ng oras para rito.#$e#Bilang magulang, wala akong gaanong panahong mailaan sa sarili. Kaya sinusubukan kong sulitin ang bawat minuto.

records.source: I wish I could spend more time outside, but there's so much work to do.#$e#I started wearing rubber gloves to keep my hands soft.#$e#The older you get, the more work you have to do to stay healthy.$s#$e#Ok, bye!
records.translation: Sana mas maraming oras akong makapagpalipas sa labas, pero napakaraming trabahong dapat gawin.#$e#Nagsimula akong magsuot ng guwantes na goma upang panatilihing malambot ang mga kamay ko.#$e#Habang tumatanda ka, mas marami ang kailangan mong gawin upang manatiling malusog.$s#$e#Sige, paalam!

records.source: What did you say? It's %time already? My goodness!#$e#I still have tons of work to do!$s
records.translation: Ano ang sinabi mo? %time na? Naku!#$e#Napakarami ko pang trabahong dapat gawin!$s

records.source: Where does all the time go? *sigh*#$e#I remember when Sam was a little baby wearing diapers. He was such a cute little kid.$s#$e#Don't tell him I said that.$h#$e#You must really like talking to me, huh?
records.translation: Saan napupunta ang lahat ng oras? *buntong-hininga*#$e#Naaalala ko noong munting sanggol pa si Sam na nakasuot ng lampin. Napakakaibig-ibig niyang bata.$s#$e#Huwag mong sabihin sa kaniya na sinabi ko iyon.$h#$e#Talagang gusto mo akong kausap, ano?

records.source: So you're a farmer, huh? Interesting.#$e#I've never met a farmer before.#$e#Maybe some day you can teach me how to grow vegetables.$h
records.translation: Kaya magsasaka ka, ano? Kawili-wili.#$e#Hindi pa ako nakatagpo ng magsasaka.#$e#Baka balang araw ay maturuan mo akong magtanim ng gulay.$h

records.source: $d Joja#The food at JojaMart might not be the healthiest for my family, but with such low prices you'd be crazy to shop anywhere else!|The food at Pierre's is so much fresher and healthier than anything I ever bought at JojaMart. I do miss those cheap Joja prices, though.
records.translation: $d Joja#Maaaring hindi pinakamasustansiya para sa pamilya ko ang pagkain sa JojaMart, pero sa napakababang presyo, kabaliwan ang mamili sa iba!|Higit na sariwa at masustansiya ang pagkain kay Pierre kaysa anumang nabili ko sa JojaMart. Pero nami-miss ko ang mababang presyo ng Joja.

records.source: Hi.#$e#Need something?
records.translation: Kumusta.#$e#May kailangan ka?

records.source: I'm so glad you're trying to improve that old farm.#$e#Once you've got everything in order, it's going to add a lot to our community!$h#$e#It's going to be a lot of work for you, though.#$e#Bye.
records.translation: Tuwang-tuwa akong sinusubukan mong pagandahin ang lumang bukid na iyon.#$e#Kapag naayos mo na ang lahat, malaki ang maidaragdag nito sa komunidad natin!$h#$e#Pero napakarami mong gagawin.#$e#Paalam.

records.source: $d kent#Yesterday I visited Yoba's Altar to give thanks for my husband's safe return.|Yesterday I visited Yoba's Altar to ask for my husband's safe return.#$e#I'm trying to stay positive, but it's hard sometimes.$s
records.translation: $d kent#Kahapon, dinalaw ko ang Altar ni Yoba upang magpasalamat sa ligtas na pagbabalik ng asawa ko.|Kahapon, dinalaw ko ang Altar ni Yoba upang hilingin ang ligtas na pagbabalik ng asawa ko.#$e#Sinusubukan kong manatiling positibo, pero mahirap kung minsan.$s

records.source: #$c .5#I'm taking a break from house chores today.$h#$e#I'm taking the day off.$h#$e#If I don't spend any time outside, I'll go crazy!#$e#Plus I don't want my legs to turn soft.
records.translation: #$c .5#Nagpapahinga ako sa mga gawaing-bahay ngayon.$h#$e#Hindi ako magtatrabaho ngayon.$h#$e#Mababaliw ako kung hindi ako magpapalipas ng oras sa labas!#$e#At ayaw kong lumambot ang mga binti ko.

records.source: I had a dream that I had complete freedom, no obligation to anyone but myself...#$b#...Then I woke up and realized I had a full day of house chores ahead of me...$s#$e#But I don't regret having a family, @... Sam and Vincent mean everything to me!
records.translation: Nanaginip akong ganap akong malaya at walang obligasyon kaninuman maliban sa sarili ko...#$b#...Pagkatapos ay nagising ako at natantong isang buong araw ng gawaing-bahay ang naghihintay sa akin...$s#$e#Pero hindi ko pinagsisisihang magkaroon ng pamilya, @... Napakahalaga sa akin nina Sam at Vincent!

records.source: Summer is nice, but it also means more work.#$e#I'll have to keep the garden in shape on top of working in the house!
records.translation: Maganda ang tag-init, pero nangangahulugan din iyon ng mas maraming trabaho.#$e#Kailangan kong panatilihing maayos ang hardin bukod pa sa pagtatrabaho sa bahay!

records.source: Hello.#$e#Do you need something? I'm a little busy.
records.translation: Kumusta.#$e#May kailangan ka ba? Medyo abala ako.

records.source: How's my little Sammy doing on the old farm?$h
records.translation: Kumusta ang munting Sammy ko sa lumang bukid?$h

records.source: Housework is frustrating because you're never finished.#$e#The day after I sweep the floor, it's dirty again.
records.translation: Nakakainis ang gawaing-bahay dahil hindi ito natatapos kailanman.#$e#Kinabukasan matapos kong walisin ang sahig, marumi na ulit iyon.

records.source: What in the world am I going to make for dinner?#$e#*sigh*...
records.translation: Ano kaya ang ihahanda ko para sa hapunan?#$e#*buntong-hininga*...

records.source: Maybe I've spoiled the boys a bit. They've never had to do any chores.#$e#I guess I want them to be able to enjoy their childhood while they still can. Well, Sam's basically a man now, though.#$b#I hope he hasn't grown up to be lazy. That won't do.$s#$e#Being a parent isn't very easy.
records.translation: Baka medyo napalayaw ko ang mga anak kong lalaki. Hindi nila kailanman kinailangang gumawa ng gawaing-bahay.#$e#Marahil gusto kong matamasa nila ang pagkabata habang maaari pa. Pero halos ganap na lalaki na si Sam ngayon.#$b#Sana hindi siya lumaking tamad. Hindi maaari iyon.$s#$e#Hindi madaling maging magulang.

records.source: Is Sam just bumming around the farm, or is he contributing?
records.translation: Nagpapalipas lang ba ng oras si Sam sa bukid o may naitutulong siya?

records.source: Caroline and I are good friends. I tell her everything.
records.translation: Mabuti kaming magkaibigan ni Caroline. Sinasabi ko sa kaniya ang lahat.

records.source: When you become a parent, you have to leave your old lifestyle behind.#$e#Maybe that's not entirely true... but if you're not careful, it will happen.
records.translation: Kapag naging magulang ka, kailangan mong iwan ang dati mong pamumuhay.#$e#Baka hindi lubos na totoo iyon... pero mangyayari iyon kung hindi ka mag-iingat.

records.source: I loved playing in the snow when I was a kid. The great thing about being a mother is that I get to enjoy it again.$h
records.translation: Gustong-gusto kong maglaro sa niyebe noong bata ako. Ang maganda sa pagiging ina ay muli ko itong natatamasa.$h

records.source: Hi. Do you get tired of people asking about your farm all the time?#$e#I think I would.
records.translation: Kumusta. Napapagod ka ba sa palaging pagtatanong ng mga tao tungkol sa bukid mo?#$e#Sa tingin ko, mapapagod ako.

records.source: *sigh*... Sometimes I dream about life on my own... without a family to look after. Is that horrible?$s#$e#Don't tell anyone.$4
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Minsan ay nangangarap ako ng sariling buhay... walang pamilyang aalagaan. Masama ba iyon?$s#$e#Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman.$4

records.source: What do I do for fun? Hmm... That's a good question.#$e#I like sleeping.$s
records.translation: Ano ang ginagawa ko para magsaya? Hmm... Magandang tanong iyan.#$e#Gusto kong matulog.$s

records.source: Kent has been home for a while now, but he still seems uneasy.$s
records.translation: Matagal-tagal nang nakauwi si Kent, pero mukhang hindi pa rin siya mapalagay.$s

records.source: Sam makes a lot of noise with that music of his. I hope it doesn't disturb the neighbors.
records.translation: Maingay si Sam sa musikang iyon. Sana hindi nito naaabala ang mga kapitbahay.

records.source: How's Sam doing? I have to admit, there's less cooking and cleaning to do since he moved out...
records.translation: Kumusta si Sam? Aaminin ko, mas kaunti ang pagluluto at paglilinis mula nang lumipat siya...

records.source: We kind of rushed into our marriage, with Kent being a soldier and all... I hardly got a taste of youth and freedom, and now it's too late to ever go back.$s#$e#I can't believe I'm saying this to you.$4
records.translation: Medyo minadali namin ang pag-aasawa dahil sundalo si Kent... Halos hindi ko natikman ang kabataan at kalayaan, at huli na ngayon upang makabalik pa.$s#$e#Hindi ako makapaniwalang sinasabi ko ito sa iyo.$4

records.source: It would be nice to take a vacation once in a while...$s
records.translation: Masarap sanang magbakasyon paminsan-minsan...$s

records.source: If I was rich the first thing I'd do would be to hire a maid and a chef.#$e#My goodness, that would be nice!$h
records.translation: Kung mayaman ako, ang una kong gagawin ay kumuha ng katulong at kusinero.#$e#Naku, napakasarap siguro niyon!$h

records.source: I should count my blessings more often. We have a good life here. Some people don't have enough food to eat.$s
records.translation: Dapat kong mas madalas bilangin ang mga biyaya ko. Maganda ang buhay natin dito. May ilang taong walang sapat na makain.$s
